page.overview:
Who is Juan?

Juan is the Gym Leader at Sootopolis City's Gym in the Hoenn region, who specializes in -type Pokémon, where he replaced the former Gym Leader, Wallace, in Emerald. Like Wallace he will award the player character the Rain Badge if he is defeated. He is very popular with the citizens of Sootopolis City.

Juan is a tail man with dark eyes, a small, trimmed moustache and black hair with a white streak, and two white locks standing out in the front and one on his right side of the head. Juan wears a skin tight black suit, a regal blue mantle, a white scarf with a blue gem etched into it. He also wears purple cargo shorts and a pair of white penny loafers.

Juan is described as a sophisticated and elegant but also an attractively dashing gentleman, which has enamored a lot of ladies. He emphasizes greatly on the grace and poise in battling, and hopes that fellow Trainers can battle in a graceful manner as well.

The name Juan comes from "water," as the "Jua" in "Juan" and the "wa" in "water" are pronounced the same. It is also likely that his name is a reference to legendary womanizer Don Juan, as he fits the archetype of the dashing romantic. His many female fans support this theory.
